correctness.rationale: The word has n distinct rotations since its unique oriented cyclic transitions forbid a nontrivial period. Every mixed prefix and suffix identifies a unique cyclic boundary. A homogeneous prefix contributes exactly one quotient class; mixed prefixes yield singleton quotients that merge precisely on homogeneous suffixes. Correcting for the two run-boundary splits gives equation (1), and its three disjoint regimes give \(\lambda_j=2\min\{j,a,b,n-j\}\). Summation and the Myhill–Nerode theorem yield \(2ab+3\) complete DFA states, including root, accepting and rejecting sink. Direct quotient enumeration, independent minimized-trie construction and a separate homogeneous-collision formula passed 634 parameter pairs; these finite tests are supplementary to the unbounded proof.

value.rationale: This completely computes the exact deterministic state complexity and every Myhill–Nerode layer for the smallest nonconstant binary circular run family. The result fills a natural exact-instance gap left by extremal conjugacy-language work, and yields sharp composition-dependent minimum/maximum state costs and a quadratic balanced-run benchmark. The quotient-collision accounting is substantive structural information, not merely a finite enumeration, arbitrary slice or normalization check.
